newsitem.title: UK: Securicor shares up after analyst meting.
newsitem.headline: Securicor shares up after analyst meting.

text.p: Shares in security-to-mobile phones group Securicor Plc firmed on Monday, boosted by a positive analysts meeting and talk of consolidation in the mobile telecommunications sector, dealers said.

They said a meeting held for analysts on Friday had been encouraging. "They painted a positive picture at the meeting and most people there were reasonably impressed," said one analyst, who asked not to be named.

Market-makers said shares in mobile phone companies had also been helped by a Financial Times report that Vodafone Group Plc was close to a deal which would offer fixed telecoms services to its customers.
Securicor shares were up 14-1/2p at 271-1/2 by 1000 GMT, with Vodafone up 6-1/2p at 302 and Orange Plc up a penny at 209.
Market-makers said Friday's analyst meeting was the main reason for the gain in Securicor shares.
"The move is on the back of positive feedback from the analysts meeting, and Vodafone in the FT which is interpreted as good news for Securicor," one dealer said.
